newsitem.title: USA: ConEd brings back 1,000 MW NY power plant.
newsitem.headline: ConEd brings back 1,000 MW NY power plant.

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York (ConEd) Tuesday said its 1,000 megawatt (MW) unit at its Ravenswood generating complex resumed operation following a maintenance outage that began December 6.
The Long Island City, N.Y., unit returned to service at 2300 EST Monday, a ConEd spokesman said.
"Ravenswood unit 3 is currently at 373 megawatts (MW)," he added.
The utility performed maintenance tasks on Ravenswoods 3's boiler, valves, turbine and water discharge system, he said.
ConEd is the operator the operator and sole owner of the Ravenswood units, which use fuel oil and/or natural gas to generate electricity.
